title: Transcript lane has no cage-era ingestion path; corpus has had zero transcript ingest since 2026-07-18
wanted_capability: bbox_search / bbox_sessions_list / bbox_cite over current Claude Code and Codex transcripts. Today the cage corpus daemon has no transcript source at all: bbox_stats reports "claude: (no projects dir)", bbox_sessions_list returns zero sessions, and a term present in local ~/.claude/projects transcripts since at least Aug 20 (e.g. "cerebras") returns zero hits in both smart and fulltext mode. The legacy bbox-collector satellite shipped transcripts to the retired bbox-corpus tailnet host until 2026-07-18 (corpus went unreachable, collector shut down, launchd plist renamed .disabled the same hour) and was never re-pointed at the cage: the bbox-collector crate and its /internal/records daemon ingress exist only on branch salvage/satellite-arc-20260718, never merged, so the deployed cage image cannot accept transcript records even if the old binary were re-enabled. Wanted: a cage-era transcript ingest lane (revive/merge the satellite arc against the cage producer-auth model, or generalize bbox-code-collector / the connector transport to ship provider transcript roots), plus backfill of the roughly six-week local-only window.
missing_primitive: A transcript-shipping transport from checkout hosts to the cage corpus daemon (satellite collector plus daemon-side producer ingress), analogous to the code_collection and source_connectors lanes in cage-daemon.toml
fallback_used: Raw rg over ~/.claude/projects on the checkout host (how the miss was noticed); no corpus-side workaround exists.
evidence: ~/Library/Logs/bbox-collector.log tail: corpus unreachable backoff then 'collector shutting down' 2026-07-18T09:03Z
~/.config/blackbox/cage-daemon.toml: code_collection + source_connectors producer stanzas exist, no transcript lane
rg 'internal/records' over src/ and crates/ on beta/blackbox-v2: zero hits; bbox-collector crate only on salvage/satellite-arc-20260718 (commits 15101067, 1de9de9e, 825c383b)

knowledge:72d2dcb38bf3190d (Aug 14) lists host satellites without bbox-collector, while PROJECT.md still claims 'checkout-bound collectors (code, transcripts)'
notes: Reported by another agent 2026-09-01 (cerebras zero-hit repro). A bbox_reindex cannot help: the cage daemon has no transcript roots to scan. The local transcript history is intact on the checkout host, so a revived lane can backfill the gap window. PROJECT.md's Runtime section should be corrected or the lane restored so doc and reality agree.
